system.name: AMAGO
system.one_liner: An in-context RL agent that trains a long-sequence Transformer over entire rollouts with off-policy actor-critic updates at every timestep in parallel.

content.variant_note: three timestep columns (0, j, H) share one full-width Transformer banner; a numbered two-step setting sits at the left
content.argues: One Transformer over the whole trajectory, with actor and critic heads at every timestep trained in parallel, unifies off-policy RL with long-sequence memory and adaptation.
content.subject: Per-timestep token chips, encoders and representations feeding one long-sequence Transformer, with actor, latent-estimate and critic outputs at each timestep.

encoding.color_means: one colour per token type (obs. pink-violet, action teal, reward lilac, reset red, goal yellow, time orange); the Actor head repeats the action colour and the Critic head the reward colour; green = encoder and Transformer; grey = latent estimate; near-black = timestep representation
encoding.line_style_means: dotted vertical lines run between the layers; solid short arrows with heads mark the encoder-to-representation step and the flows into the heads
encoding.shape_means: rounded black-outlined tile = a token, representation or head; wide banner = the sequence model over all timesteps; offset stack of cards = several heads or value horizons
encoding.marker_means: 1. and 2. order the setting; subscripts 0, j, H index the timesteps; labels under the first chips name the token types
encoding.emphasis: The AMAGO banner is the largest and most saturated block and spans the full width, so the one-Transformer-over-everything idea dominates; the output label points with a small double arrow at the stacked critic cards.

new_tags.name: timestep-columns
new_tags.what: the same stack of blocks repeated for time steps 0, j and H with ellipses between and one sequence model spanning all columns

lessons.what_to_learn: Unroll a sequence model by drawing the first, a generic and the last timestep as aligned columns with ellipses, one small encoder per column under a single full-width banner for the sequence model, and repeat the output heads per column; keep one fixed colour per token type so it can be followed up the stack.
lessons.suits: Agents or models that run one shared backbone over every step of a trajectory or sequence (RL, time series, video) and train per-step heads in parallel.

evidence: we redesign the off-policy actor-critic update from scratch to support long-sequence Transformers that learn from entire rollouts in parallel
we use a timestep encoder network to map each timestep to a fixed-size representation

summary: AMAGO is an in-context reinforcement-learning agent that runs one long-sequence Transformer over entire rollouts and trains actor and critic heads off-policy at every timestep in parallel, targeting generalization, memory and meta-learning. Figure 1 puts a numbered two-step setting at the left (sample an environment with unknown parameters e and a goal g, then adapt over up to H timesteps) with a globe and a robot icon. Beside it a bottom-up stack shows colour-coded token chips (obs., action, reward, reset, goal, time) per timestep, a Timestep Encoder under each, black representation tiles, one full-width green AMAGO banner, and an actor, latent-estimate and critic triple above timesteps 0, j and H.
summary_zh: AMAGO 用跨整条轨迹的长序列 Transformer，在每个时间步并行做离线 actor-critic 训练。左侧两步编号说明设定，右侧自下而上是彩色 token、编码器、通栏 Transformer 和 actor、critic。
notes: All boxes, chips and banners are placed as bitmap tiles (66 pictures) with live text over them, so shapes are not vector paths. The colour key under the chips appears only once, under the first timestep. I added stage-pipeline as a second kind because the left strip states a two-step protocol; the main drawing is model-anatomy.
